author_boundary: Independent reviewer, not author of native_owned, native_backing, or private_lifecycle. Added only this report and separate scenarios/replay under runs/.

findings.fact: One boot-retained noncopyable native anchor owns actual OSPtr descriptors, callback context and manager. That manager embeds one unchanged c585 registry. Acquisition stores the exact canonical lease in the job; its actual retained refs/validated spans are used by recheck and the same job lease is journaled at dispatch. Public facade has no raw descriptor/view/registry/lease accessor and links no old provider implementation. No independent side registry or detached fake cohort substitutes for native ownership.

Real adapter ops fix dispatch=null and availability0. After token/state/shape/alias/canonical metadata admission, bno_run returns BNO_UNAVAILABLE before recheck/native queries, sequence consumption, begin, dispatch or output/history changes. TEST dispatch requires explicit original TEST SDK and is refused with KERNEL in both public values and adapter source. Invalid requests can refuse before unavailable; they are not promoted to success.

Initialization copies ops; public run captures bounded token/request values before any native callback. Native context is the retained anchor itself and fixed code/table residency is a platform obligation. Short locks protect metadata, domain busy covers unlocked queries and dispatch, and public mutations reject callback reentry. Per-invocation internal views do not escape through outputs or public APIs. Internal privileged code is still trusted; this is not protection against malicious C/C++ casts or manager memory writes.

Available host path reserves three query sequence values plus dispatch, rechecks all actual identities/spans and held explicit pairs, then bpl_effect_begin commits same-lease pending/resource history before unlocked synchronous dispatch. Result sequence/generation/slot/operation/ticket/outcome/error and every retained identity must match. Core validates the exact pending ticket. Supported success records callback success only, never physical delivery/completion.

Only never-exposed private_core allows complete/reset/retire; effect-retained query access is narrowly separate and does not weaken private gates. Any effect forever blocks zero/copy/private cleanup even after success. Failed/unknown/malformed/replayed result or changed bound view quarantines and halts domain, preserving first error and every still-owned ref/preparation/claim. Nonreturn remains busy/pending and blocks work indefinitely; no timeout/free mechanism or synthetic return is present. Private-reset uncertainty may already have released refs and remains explicitly distinguished.

findings.fact: 32 lifetime begins per lease are retained without refund/reset/compaction; entry33 refuses before queries or dispatch. Four sequence values are reserved before callbacks; MAX through MAX-3 refuse and MAX-4 admits one bounded operation ending at MAX-1. No batch reservation or continuous driver is implemented. Future multi-operation workloads must add a separately reviewed whole-chain budget, not infer it from this single-op API.

External token/request/output ranges must avoid full control, protected CPU and bound owned spans; output also cannot alias token/request. Values are copied before callbacks. Foreign/stale identity refuses without quarantining an unrelated owner. Bound spans are checked before mutation; invalid provisional views are not treated as validated-owned ranges merely to reject diagnostic inspection.

Current synthetic grammar requires WRITE for DESCRIPTOR/SUBMIT and READ for MAPPING. It rejects READ-only TX-like submission and WRITE-only mapping before native queries/begin. These are explicit host-profile rules with no hardware schema, not a correct general decoder of device DMA permissions or CPU writability. CPU writes by TEST dispatch do not authorize promoting a future real READ-only TX lease to RW. Future native operation/DMA profiles must independently specify permissions and preserve least rights; this source does not validate those future semantics.

existing_frozen_suite.scope: Actual coordinator and native adapter source exercised only with original host memory/reference/API stand-ins; no XNU API executed.

cases: Four simultaneously owned canonical leases/cohorts interleave32 effects each, checking exact lease/ref/pending ties and irreversible retention; each33rd refuses before queries/output change.
A complete-looking success replay from another cohort quarantines the current cohort, globally halts admission and retains all12 refs with zero complete/reset.
Caller ops mutation after initialization cannot redirect copied dispatch. Foreign-generation refusals do not poison other live owners.

READ-only submit and WRITE-only mapping refuse with no query/begin/output change; profile-approved converse operations succeed without changing stored permissions. These are synthetic grammar checks, not a prescription of native DMA rights.

target_evidence.author_precheck: Frozen manifest retains authorized mutable real-framework object/frame prechecks only. Reviewer did not run a target compiler. Root owns final exact frozen-source genuine-framework O0/O2/mixed-link/import/frame receipt; it is separate from this source review.

limitations: One installed owner per physical resource domain remains a trusted platform obligation; a local canonical registry cannot detect another independently configured owner.
Internal owned.h types/ops and raw pin/configure are trusted module interfaces, not an isolation boundary. Public facade does not expose backing authority.

Callback/context/code and input/output lifetimes require trusted serialization/residency. A synchronous callback that never returns consumes busy/pending ownership; no safe cancellation or reclamation exists.
32 effects is a finite first-workload limit, not continuous mapping/IRQ/submission support. No multi-op chain reservation is implemented.
Physical RAM/protection completeness and control address derivation are still missing until separately authorized Step2. Native effect backend remains unavailable.
No hardware writer, DMA/MSI, endpoint/firmware initialization, physical drain/free, ACTIVE, Wi-Fi or new runtime result follows this source review.
